items.description: Designated LB Yasir Abdullah to return from injured reserve. Placed DE Samson Ebukam on injured reserve. Signed LB Drake Jackson to the practice squad. Released T Colby Sorsdal from the practice squad.
Released S C.J. Gardner-Johnson.
Placed DE Cashius Howell on injured reserve.

Signed G Austin Blaske, WR Xavier Guillory and T Xavier Truss to the practice squad. Released T Andrew Coker, G Vershon Lee and P Wes Pahl from the practice squad. Released WR Bub Means from practice squad injured reserve.
Signed RB Jaret Patterson, DT Jordan Miller and DB Ugo Amadi to the practice squad. Released WRs Eli Pancol and Cam Ross from the practice squad.
Placed LB Jimmy Rolder on injured reserve. Waived DB Bishop Fitzgerald.
Signed LB D.J. Johnson, QB Cam Miller and S John Saunders Jr. to the practice squad. Released S Kahlef Hailassie from the practice squad.
Signed DT Adetomiwa Adebawore to a contract extension.
Signed DE Anthony Goodlow to the practice squad. Released T Darian Kinnard from the practice squad.

Signed DB Cam Lampkin from the practice squad to the active roster. Signed DB Nyzier Fourqurean to the practice squad. Placed RB Dean Connors on injured reserve. Released WR Alex Bachman. Released LB Garrett Nelson from the practice squad.
Waived G Trevor Keegan. Released TE Bryson Nesbit from the practice squad.
Reinstated T Marcus Bryant from injured reserve. Signed LB Elias Neal to the practice squad. Released CB Kindle Vildor. Released WR Cameron Dorner and OL Jake Kubas from the practice squad.
Claimed RB Audric Estime off waivers from Cleveland. Released K Daniel Carlson.
Signed T Blake Freeland from Cincinnati's practice squad. Placed T Max Mitchell on injured reserve. Released DB Tre Brown from injured reserve.
Waived CB Jakorian Bennett from injured reserve. Released WR Quentin Skinner from the practice squad.

Signed WR Harrison Wallace III from the practice squad to the active roster. Signed TE Rivaldo Fairweather to the practice squad. Placed WR Kendrick Bourne and RB Jeremiyah Love on injured reserve. Placed TE Kenny Yeboah on practice squad injured reserve. Released DL Cam Horsley from the practice squad.
Signed DL Robert Beal Jr. to the practice squad.
Claimed RB Robert Henry off waivers from Seattle. Placed DTs Javon Kinlaw and Daron Payne and RB Jeremy McNichols on injured reserve.
Designated G Brady Christensen to return from injured reserve. Released DB Robert Rochell from the practice squad.
Placed DT Davon Hamilton and DB Eric Murray on injured reserve.
Signed QB Kedon Slovis from Green Bay's practice squad. Placed K Tyler Loop on injured reserve.

Waived RB Audric Estime.
Released CB Kader Kohou from the practice squad.
